reasoning_chain: Multiple callers (frontend and checkoutservice) show 100% errors calling currencyservice, indicating currencyservice is the root cause.
frontend->checkoutservice also shows 100% errors, but checkoutservice->currencyservice fails at the same rate, so checkoutservice is relaying currencyservice's failure, not a separate fault.
currencyservice has no pods at all, confirming it is down and causing the failures.
Other services on the critical path (productcatalogservice, cartservice) show no errors and low latency, so they are not the root cause.
The missing calls from checkoutservice to paymentservice and others are due to low throughput, not faults.
